visible.message:
My st.button on_click callbacks fire on every rerun without a click. When I edit and save my script so the app reruns, the balloons and snow from both callbacks appear. Here is my code:

def handle_upsert():
    st.balloons()

st.button('Create or Update', on_click=handle_upsert)

def handle_remove(args):
    st.snow()

st.button('Remove', on_click=handle_remove, args=('12123123122135',))

I have not supplied my Streamlit version.
